scope: Generated synthetic CSV and disposable verified offline package; no serial port or real-time run.
fixture_definition: 600 rows; sequence skips two identities after row 299; gateway receipt jumps three extra seconds at row 300; 6 ADXL345, 4 DS18B20 and 2 INA219 invalid groups; one valid current zero.

timing.basis: declared gateway receipt times of accepted records in source order

summary.limitations: Descriptive statistics only. Quarantined records are excluded from timing and sensor counts. Receipt span is not capture duration or sensor sampling rate. H1 still requires start/stop records, stop reason, first-600-second counts, reference comparisons and independent physical review. No threshold or acceptance decision is applied.

limitations: 600 records are not a measured 600-second capture. The synthetic receipt span is 602 seconds with a four-second gap. No H1 acceptance decision or real sensor performance is established. The temporary package was discarded; this snapshot does not include its source archive.
